{{Short description|Canadian physicist (born 1965)}}
'''Jeremy J. Whitlock''' (born  September 15, 1965) is a section head in the Dept. of Safeguards at the [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] in Vienna.  He has a Ph.D. in engineering physics from [[McMaster University]] and formerly worked at [[Canadian Nuclear Laboratories]].

He was past president and director of the [[Canadian Nuclear Society]] (CNS)<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/nuclear-waste-in-your-backyard-1.794486|title=Nuclear waste in your backyard?|date=August 19, 2009|publisher=[[CBC.ca]]|access-date=June 21, 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theglobeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20060615.gtcampbell15/TPStory/National/columnists|date=June 15, 2006|work=[[The Globe and Mail]]|accessdate=June 21, 2010|location=Toronto|first=Murray|last=Campbell |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060617075635/https://www.theglobeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20060615.gtcampbell15/TPStory/National/columnists |archive-date=June 17, 2006 |title=	
Beleaguered nuclear industry gets new lease on life
}}</ref> and a past board member of the [[American Nuclear Society]].
